description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter 'NotesAdapter' for displaying a list of notes in an Android application. It manages the creation and binding of view holders, which display note title, content preview, and last updated date. It uses DiffUtil for efficient list updates and provides click handling for note items.

classes.name: NotesAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of Note objects with click handling.

classes.name: VH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for notes, binds note data to UI components.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder, inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds the data to the ViewHolder for a given position.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Note object to UI components in the ViewHolder.
